logic.entry: While cash, prior completed close strictly > mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1+band).
logic.exit: While long, prior completed close strictly < mean of prior N completed daily closes * (1-band). Equality/deadband preserves state.
logic.sizing: All available component cash buys spot at next 00:01 UTC minute open, after costs; no leverage, borrowing, periodic rebalance or transfers. USDT yield=0.

costs.impact: 0.5 * strictly previous20completedUTCdays sample log-close volatility * sqrt(reference order upper-bound cash budget or sell reference notional / previous20day quote ADV)
costs.funding_borrow: Not applicable to unlevered long-only spot; no spot short or borrow.
costs.execution_limitations: Reuse existing daily floating-quantity accounting; no historical L2, tick/lot/min-notional or minute capacity calibration. Daily close NAV does not include full intraday drawdown.

parameters.observation_terminal_action: Mark only; no artificial liquidation; preserve units/cash for continuing frozen plan
parameters.qualification: Partial shadow snapshot; minimum180days not reached; no long-run pass/fail inference

parameters.persistence: Keep actual long while ROC>-E or short while ROC<E inside entrybands;strict entrybands have priority,unchanged quantity.

logic.signal: At daily decision i,priorcompletedperpetualROC=C[i-1]/C[i-1-L]-1. Flat enterslong iff ROC>H,short iff ROC<-H. Inside or on entrybands,existinglong persists strictly while ROC>-E;existingshort persists strictly while ROC<E. Long exits at ROC<=-E;short exits at ROC>=E. Crossing opposite strict fullentryband closesold then opensopposite at00:01. E<=H,at exact +/-H no newentry. State is actualsignedquantity,no unpublishedprice/funding input.
logic.execution: NextUTC00:01 nativeOPEN;closeopposite first then enter. Quantity=floor(spec.fixed_entry_notional_usdt/priorcompletedC/lot)*lot times direction;fixed raw N,no future OPEN/NAV/unpublishedfunding sizing;retain actualsame-directionquantity.
logic.allocation: Independent10000USDT collateral;raw N1000/2000/3000 means10/20/30percent fixed initialcollateral per newentry,not targetweight rebalancing or NAV-scaled compound size. No borrowing/transfer/cashyield. Existing1x fullycollateralized postfee entrycap unchanged.
logic.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
logic.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
logic.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
